### Vision
To strive students for affirming quality through innovation in technical education.

### Mission
- To contribute in magnified education that enumerates and accomplishes brilliance in teaching learning process and innovation.
- To create passion amongst students for contributing to research by providing industry exposure.
- To inspire students and faculty by providing them various opportunities with industry oriented learning
- To develop professional attitude, moral and ethical values among students for society
